slides.bodyContent: Marketing Student | Content Creator | Creative Communication

I’m particularly interested in Brand Marketing, Content Marketing and Creative Communication, where strategy and creativity come together to solve real consumer problems.

slides.bodyContent: A self-initiated campaign project exploring how brands can build meaningful connections with Gen Z through social media.
highlights: Challenge: Explore how a lifestyle brand can increase relevance among Gen Z consumers in an increasingly crowded social media environment.

My Approach: Conducted desk research and social listening to understand Gen Z’s interests and behaviors. Identified key consumer tensions and developed a communication insight. Built a campaign concept based on the identified insight. Developed the Big Idea, Key Message and Communication Direction. Created sample social media content across different stages of the campaign.
Project Output: Consumer Insight, Creative Concept, Key Message, Content Pillars, Social Media Content Ideas
Marketing: Consumer Research, Consumer Insight, Brand Strategy, Campaign Planning, Social Media Strategy
Creative: Copywriting, Content Ideation, Storytelling, Creative Concept Development
Tools: Canva, Figma, Google Slides, Google Sheets, CapCut
What kind of work excites you the most? I enjoy projects where I can start with a consumer problem, find an interesting insight and turn it into an idea that people can actually relate to.

What is one thing you’re constantly trying to improve? I’m constantly working on becoming better at connecting creativity with strategy. I don’t want to create something that simply looks good — I want to understand why the idea should work.
What is your working style? I like having a clear direction at the beginning, but I also enjoy exploring different ideas before deciding on the strongest solution.
What inspires your ideas? Most of my ideas come from observing everyday consumer behavior, social media conversations, trends and small cultural moments that people usually overlook.

Where do you see yourself in the next few years? I hope to develop into a brand or creative strategist who can combine consumer understanding, strategic thinking and creativity to build meaningful brands.
